title: Yellow Argentinian Sweet Potato Bake
description: A light and flavorful Argentinian dish featuring sweet potatoes, coriander, and a jammy texture, this bake is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is also ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly, making it a great option for those looking for a balancing meal.
instructions: Peel and chop the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with olive oil, coriander seeds, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and chili flakes until they are evenly coated.
Transfer the sweet potatoes to a baking dish and bake for 45 minutes.
After 45 minutes, increase the oven temperature to 425 degrees and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and caramelized.
Remove the sweet potatoes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the sweet potatoes hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
